summary: 253 holdings; the top ten are 28% of the portfolio.
Trades a lot: about 153% of the portfolio changes in a year.
The average holding, by value, has been owned for 1.4 years.
Compared with the typical S&P 500 company, its holdings are similarly priced and faster-growing.

profile.background: George Soros founded Soros Fund Management in 1970 and the Quantum Fund with Jim Rogers in 1973. Stanley Druckenmiller managed Quantum from 1988 to 2000. Since 2011 it has been a family office; Dawn Fitzpatrick has been chief investment officer since 2017.
profile.approach: Macro investing across currencies, bonds and shares, plus investments with outside managers.
known: Made about $1.8 billion betting against the British pound in September 1992.
Reported to have averaged about 20% a year from 1973 to 2010.
profile.note: These are the family office's holdings, chosen by its investment team rather than by George Soros himself. The 13F shows only US shares.
